original.citation: DiMarco, Howard, Nowlin Jr. and Reid (2004), Subsurface, High-Speed Current Jets in the Deepwater Region of the Gulf of Mexico, Final Report, OCS Study MMS 2004-022, July 2004.

source_classification.source_locator: Section 3.1.4, printed page 25 / PDF page 37, continuing the VK956 discussion from printed page 18 / PDF page 30.
source_classification.underlying_information_as_reported: Authors attribute the feature description to Eddy Watch charts during the VK956 case; those original provider charts have not been independently recovered.
source_classification.period_role: ADCP case discussion context, not verified individual formation, observation interval or lifetime
source_classification.relative_location_as_reported: North of the measurements; not an exact measured eddy center.

identity_association.basis: The source names Easy Eddy in the February 1997 case. The Horizon Easy record has initial separation January 31, 1997 and month-resolution dissipation March 1997. These supply name/date context only.

measurement_exclusions.source_quantity: 105 cm/s jet maximum near 300 m, roughly six-hour event
measurement_exclusions.decision: Local VK956 subsurface jet diagnostic. Do not assign to Easy as swirl speed, penetration depth or eddy lifetime. The source only places Easy north of the measurement site.

measurement_exclusions.source_quantity: Figure 3.1.4-3 SSH map dated February 10, 1997, 2.5 cm contour intervals
measurement_exclusions.decision: The map does not label an individual Easy contour. The prose distinguishes a weak warm slope anticyclone south of the measurements from the cold-core cyclone to the north. Do not identify the warm high as Easy or derive dimensions from it.

measurement_exclusions.source_quantity: General Loop Current eddy or neighboring named-eddy scales
measurement_exclusions.decision: Do not assign generic warm-ring dimensions, Creole extents, Deviant positions or nearby jet profiles to Easy.

next_evidence_needed: Recover an explicitly named or otherwise independently associated Easy provider chart for this case.
Resolve individual registry/source identity and circulation type before selecting a field extremum or using a polarity-specific contour method.
Require a declared boundary/level and all measurable extrema before producing a size reference; keep site diagnostics and eddy-wide quantities separate.
